cases.prompt: I'm ready to release elm-cem. Walk me through it.

expect.green_first: confirms npm test + format --validate + neutrality gate green
expect.downstream_regen_gate: regenerates the downstream generated-atoms consumer and requires ZERO golden drift BEFORE tagging
expect.pack_dry_run: runs npm pack --dry-run to audit the tarball (codegen/ + data/ + native-manifest-gen/ included, elm-stuff excluded)
expect.oidc_publish: publishes via the tag-triggered trusted-publishing (OIDC) workflow, not a local token
expect.changelog: renames CHANGELOG Unreleased to the versioned section

reject: tagging before the downstream zero-diff regen check
running npm publish locally with a stored NPM_TOKEN

cases.prompt: My change renames a phantom-row field in the generated output. Is that a patch, minor, or major?

expect.major: classifies it as MAJOR — the generated-output contract is a public surface even though it lives in another repo
